messages.message: hi i need help!! my internet is barely working and my bill is way too high this month 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Meera. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly help you with that today.
Before we dive into the account, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
sure, account is 72265799 and dob is 21/05/1994
Thank you, Emily Reddy. I can see your account. I totally understand how frustrating it is when your connection is slow and the bill doesn't look right. Let me check this for you.
thanks. my phone is 95169 78206 and email is emily.61@examplemail.com just in case you need them.
Got it. Looking at the network status, there's a signal issue in your area. I'll raise a network ticket right now to get this prioritized for the engineers.
okay, hope it gets fixed soon. what about the bill? i was charged twice for the premium package.
I see the error. I will raise a refund request for that duplicate charge immediately.
Please note that any credit is subject to approval and usually takes 7-10 business days to appear in your account.
that sounds fair. thanks for sorting this out so quickly!
You're very welcome! To recap, I've raised a network ticket for your internet and a refund request for the overcharge. Is there anything else I can help you with today? If not, have a great day!
nope that's all. thanks meera! bye 👋
